english.title: Carry / remove / deposit etc. prohibited weapons / ammunition with intent to evade a prohibition / restriction

english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(1)(b) (3) and (4A) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

date and location

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(ii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions
(iii) For the offence wording relating to goods other than weapons and ammunition see H3639.
(iv) This offence was inserted by section 293(4) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine of the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods, whichever is the greater.
INDICTMENT: Life imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
